mapper.sql: FROM JOB_TB j INNER JOIN QUO_TB q ON q.QUO_YM = j.QUO_YM AND q.QUO_SEQ = j.QUO_SEQ AND q.STATE <> 'D' INNER JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB ti ON ti.QUO_YM = j.QUO_YM AND ti.QUO_SEQ = j.QUO_SEQ AND ti.STATE <> 'D' LEFT JOIN CMPY_TB c ON c.CMPY_SEQ = j.CMPY_SEQ WHERE j.STATE <> 'D' AND IFNULL(j.MNG_ID, '') <> ''
mapper.select:
SELECT j.MNG_ID AS mngId, IFNULL(FN_MEM_NAME(j.MNG_ID), j.MNG_ID) AS mngName, IFNULL(SUM(q.ISSUE_DT >= ), 0) AS curCnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(q.ISSUE_DT >= , ti.NET_SALES, 0)) / 10000, 0), 0) AS curNetMan, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(q.ISSUE_DT >= , j.CMPY_SEQ, NULL)) AS curCustCnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(q.ISSUE_DT >= AND c.CMPY_CODE = '1000', ti.NET_SALES, 0)) / 10000, 0), 0) AS curDirectMan, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(q.ISSUE_DT >= AND ti.TEST_TYPE_CODE IN ('MD', 'SR', 'RF'), ti.NET_SALES, 0)) / 10000, 0), 0) AS curHiMan, IFNULL(SUM(q.ISSUE_DT < ), 0) AS prevCnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(q.ISSUE_DT < , ti.NET_SALES, 0)) / 10000, 0), 0) AS prevNetMan
AND ( q.ISSUE_DT BETWEEN AND CURDATE() OR q.ISSUE_DT BETWEEN AND ) GROUP BY j.MNG_ID, mngName HAVING curNetMan > 0 OR prevNetMan > 0

SELECT j.MNG_ID AS mngId, ti.TEST_TYPE_CODE AS deptCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(ti.NET_SALES) / 10000, 0), 0) AS netMan
AND q.ISSUE_DT BETWEEN AND CURDATE() GROUP BY j.MNG_ID, ti.TEST_TYPE_CODE
SELECT TYPE_CD AS code, TYPE_NAME AS name FROM COMCODE_TB WHERE TOP_CD = 'TT' ORDER BY TYPE_CD
